name: sme-fused-a-panel-staged-loads
hypothesis: Start from sme-fused-a-panel-unroll2, the strongest measured source. For complete output tiles, load both reduction steps before issuing their outer products, use all-true predicates, and advance input pointers directly. This can hide load latency and reduce address work while retaining the measured A-panel packing scheme and unpacked B. Edge tiles retain predicated loads and stores. This candidate is untested; the supplied timing spread does not establish throughput above 1780 GFLOP/s.
